$comment: Digests of the two source documents the standards are derived from. Recorded once, on 2026-08-09, and never regenerated from a run — the same guarantee artifacts/standards-source-inventory.json carries, for the same reason. The rule integrity.provenance-digest recomputes these and fails if either source has changed. WHY THIS EXISTS: the cheapest way to make a standard true is to edit the prompt it claims to implement. Fidelity checking would still pass, because fidelity compares a standard against the source and the source is what moved. This file is the fixed point that makes that edit loud (Standard 21).
normalization: Carriage returns are stripped before hashing, then the text is hashed as UTF-8. Line endings differ between checkouts on Windows and Linux; the content does not, and it is the content these digests are about.
